body.name: Denominator-locked selected conditional certificate
body.construction: \(\Gamma\) contains a reachable terminal state \(\rho\), a represented \(\mathcal M\in[\mathcal P]_{\mathsf M}\), a represented \(\mathcal G\in[\mathcal M]_{\mathsf G}\), nested \(R_F\)-rooted C-forests \(F'\subsetneq F\) satisfying the terminal selected-hedge predicates for the entire terminal intervention, and \(\mathbf M_0,\mathbf M_1\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{rat,bin}}^+(\mathcal P)\) with equal full selected observational laws, \(D_{\rho,\mathbf M_0}=D_{\rho,\mathbf M_1}>0\), and \(N_{\rho,\mathbf M_0}\neq N_{\rho,\mathbf M_1}\), together with dense exact rational tables.
